name: Tycho
game_note: Bright rays stretch over 1,500 km; Surveyor 7 landed on its rim ejecta.

name: Copernicus
game_note: Terraced walls and central peaks; about 800 million years old.

name: Kepler
game_note: Named for Johannes Kepler; bright rays over Oceanus Procellarum.

name: Aristarchus
game_note: The brightest feature on the nearside - young, on a rise with volcanic rilles.

name: Plato
game_note: Dark smooth floor inside bright walls: an old crater flooded by mare basalt.

name: Clavius
game_note: Huge ancient crater with a chain of smaller craters curving across its floor.

name: Shackleton
game_note: Rim is ~80-90 percent sunlit over a year while the floor never sees the Sun - a prime Artemis-era landing target.

name: Cabeus
game_note: LCROSS impact site (2009): the ejecta plume confirmed water ice in the floor.
source_name: NASA NSSDCA - Ice on the Moon

name: Hermite
game_note: Coldest measured place in the solar system floor region: 26 K measured by LRO Diviner.
source_name: NASA SSERVI - LRO Finds Coldest Place on the Moon

name: Tsiolkovskiy
game_note: Rare far-side lava floor, making it a bright-dark landmark of the far hemisphere.

name: Apollo
game_note: Named for the Apollo program; sits inside the South Pole-Aitken basin. Chang'e 6 landed near its edge.

name: Von Karman
game_note: Chang'e 4 and Yutu-2 rover landed inside it in 2019 - the first far-side landing.

name: Peary
game_note: Near the north pole; LRO Diviner measured floors down to 29-31 K.
source_name: NASA SSERVI - LRO Finds Coldest Place on the Moon
